identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a distinct, high-performance Italian business dashboard that breaks the 'generic SaaS' mold.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix finance precision with high-contrast Swiss aesthetics.
Emotion First: The dashboard should feel 'Authoritative' and 'Precise'.
Content is King: Data density without clutter. Every pixel must earn its keep.
Negative Space: Use spacing to group logic, not just for decoration.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode. No muddy greys.

usage.headings: Barlow Condensed, font-weight: 700/800, uppercase for section titles, tracking-tight

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

style_overrides.buttons: uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-xs h-10 px-6
style_overrides.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-input border-t-0 border-x-0 rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary px-0 transition-colors
style_overrides.cards: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-none relative overflow-hidden
style_overrides.tables: compact, text-sm, border-collapse, header uppercase text-muted-foreground text-xs tracking-wider

specific_effects.tracing_border: Use for active upload zones or focused inputs
specific_effects.stagger_list: Stagger children by 0.05s for table rows and list items

csv_upload.title: Importazione Dati
key_elements: Drag & Drop Zone (Large, dashed border, animated)
csv_upload.visual_style: Tracing Beam effect on the drop zone when dragging.

textures.noise: Add a subtle fixed noise overlay at 2-3% opacity to the entire app body for a premium feel.

visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use ASCII art or minimal geometric outlines instead of generic illustrations.

implementation_instructions.step_1: Install dependencies: `npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge recharts date-fns` (or yarn equivalent)
implementation_instructions.step_2: Initialize Shadcn/UI structure (manually or via CLI if available). Ensure `lib/utils.js` exists.
implementation_instructions.step_3: Create basic UI components (Button, Card, Input) with the specified overrides.
implementation_instructions.step_5: Build pages sequentially: Dashboard -> CSV Upload -> Inventory -> Others.
implementation_instructions.step_6: Apply the 'Performance Pro' color theme in `tailwind.config.js` and `index.css`.
implementation_instructions.step_7: Ensure all text is in Italian.

do_not: Use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl (stick to rounded-sm or rounded-md).
Center text in tables (align left for text, right for numbers).
Use generic 'Lorem Ipsum' - use realistic Italian business data.
must_do: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.
